eps.o: Zak and the crew must separate fact from fiction as they investigate strange goings-on inside a sprawling Las Vegas warehouse-turned-escape room.
Zak and the crew are unexpectedly called to help a panic-stricken man confront potentially deadly demonic forces in his rural Oregon home.
Zak and the crew gain access to a palatial California estate where spectral nuns roam its halls.
The crew investigates a Nevada mining town where visitors are being attacked by unseen forces.
